units.title: Purpose of the callback policy
units.text: This policy tells pharmacy advocates and insurance advocates how to promise a return call, what to say when they promise it, and what happens when the call is missed.
units.source_span: This policy tells pharmacy advocates and insurance advocates how to promise a return call, what to say when they promise it, and what happens when the call is missed.

units.title: Single training source for both queues
units.text: This page is the one advocates train to on either queue.
units.source_span: The page is the one advocates train to on either queue.

units.title: Scope: service line and question types
units.text: The policy covers callbacks on the Harbor Medicare Advantage service line for pharmacy questions and for medical benefit questions.
units.source_span: The policy covers callbacks on the Harbor Medicare Advantage service line for pharmacy questions and for medical benefit questions.

units.title: Scope: advocates covered
units.text: The policy covers the advocate who is ending the first call and the advocate who places the return call.
units.source_span: It covers the advocate who is ending the first call and the advocate who places the return call.

units.title: Scope exclusions: prices, copays, deadlines
units.text: The policy does not set drug prices, visit copays beyond the training example in the procedures section, appeal deadlines, or prior authorization clocks. Those stay in the pharmacy and benefits guides.
units.source_span: It does not set drug prices, visit copays beyond the training example in the procedures section, appeal deadlines, or prior authorization clocks. Those stay in the pharmacy and benefits guides.

units.title: Scope exclusion: weekends and holidays
units.text: Weekend coverage and holiday coverage are outside this version of the policy.
units.source_span: Weekend coverage and holiday coverage are outside this version of the page.

units.title: Definition: callback
units.text: A callback means a return phone call from Harbor Health to the member or the authorized caregiver.
units.source_span: A callback means a return phone call from Harbor Health to the member or the authorized caregiver.

units.title: Definition: window
units.text: A window means the block of time the advocate promised for that return call.
units.source_span: A window means the block of time the advocate promised for that return call.

units.title: Definition: desk note
units.text: A desk note means the note on the member record that the next advocate can read.
units.source_span: A desk note means the note on the member record that the next advocate can read.

units.title: Offer callback when caller cannot be verified
units.text: Offer a callback when you cannot verify the caller with two identifiers.
units.source_span: Offer a callback when you cannot verify the caller with two identifiers.

units.title: Offer callback when claim document is not on screen
units.text: Offer a callback when a medical claim question needs a document that is not on the screen.
units.source_span: Offer a callback when a medical claim question needs a document that is not on the screen.

units.title: Grievance callback condition
units.text: Offer a grievance callback only after the member asks to speak with a supervisor about a medical benefit.
units.source_span: Offer a grievance callback only after the member asks to speak with a supervisor about a medical benefit.

units.title: Nurse callback plans listed on plan benefit grid
units.text: Which plans include a nurse callback is listed on the plan benefit grid. This policy does not name the plans.
units.source_span: Which plans include a nurse callback is listed on the plan benefit grid. This policy does not name the plans.

units.title: Document reason and window in desk note
units.text: Write the callback reason and the promised window in the desk note before you end the conversation.
units.source_span: Write the callback reason and the promised window in the desk note before you end the conversation.

units.title: Call only the confirmed phone number
units.text: Place the callback only to the phone number the member confirmed during this conversation.
units.source_span: Place the callback only to the phone number the member confirmed during this conversation.

units.title: Callback scheduling hours (illustrative)
units.text: Schedule member callbacks on weekdays between 8:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. Eastern. These hours are illustrative.
units.source_span: Schedule member callbacks on weekdays between 8:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. Eastern. These hours are illustrative.

units.title: Training example specialist copay (illustrative)
units.text: The training example uses an in-network specialist copay of $45. That figure is illustrative.
units.source_span: The training example uses an in-network specialist copay of $45. That figure is illustrative.

units.title: Read callback block word for word
units.text: Read the callback block word for word before you end the call.
units.source_span: Read the callback block word for word before you end the call.

units.title: Callback promise legal script
units.text: Harbor Health will call you back on the number you just confirmed. Please keep that phone with you during the window we agreed.
units.source_span: Harbor Health will call you back on the number you just confirmed. Please keep that phone with you during the window we agreed.

units.title: What the caller says before verification
units.text: Q: Will you say why you are calling before I pick up? A: We say that Harbor Health is returning your call. We do not give the medicine name, the diagnosis, or a claim amount until we verify you.
units.source_span: Will you say why you are calling before I pick up? We say that Harbor Health is returning your call. We do not give the medicine name, the diagnosis, or a claim amount until we verify you.

units.title: No sensitive details on voicemail
units.text: Do not leave the medicine name, the diagnosis, or a claim amount on a voicemail.
units.source_span: Do not leave the medicine name, the diagnosis, or a claim amount on a voicemail.

units.title: Optional portal summary mention
units.text: You may add, in your own words, that a summary of this call will appear in the member portal within two days.
units.source_span: You may add, in your own words, that a summary of this call will appear in the member portal within two days.

units.title: Definition: missed callback
units.text: A missed callback is a return call the member does not answer during the promised window.
units.source_span: A missed callback is a return call the member does not answer during the promised window.

units.title: Retry a missed callback
units.text: If the advocate misses the window, make one more attempt within 2 business days.
units.source_span: If the advocate misses the window, make one more attempt within 2 business days.

units.title: Portal message and close after second failure
units.text: If the second attempt also fails, send a portal message on the same day and close the callback task.
units.source_span: If the second attempt also fails, send a portal message on the same day and close the callback task.

units.title: Missed callback does not extend deadlines
units.text: A missed callback does not extend a prior authorization deadline or an appeal deadline.
units.source_span: A missed callback does not extend a prior authorization deadline or an appeal deadline.

units.title: Callback completion target (illustrative)
units.text: The desk target is to complete 90 percent of callbacks inside the promised window. This figure is illustrative.
units.source_span: The desk target is to complete 90 percent of callbacks inside the promised window. This figure is illustrative.

units.title: Average callback wait reported elsewhere
units.text: The average number of minutes a member waits before a callback is reported in the monthly operations pack. This policy does not state that average.
units.source_span: The average number of minutes a member waits before a callback is reported in the monthly operations pack. This policy does not state that average.

units.title: Version and effective date
units.text: Version 1 took effect on 2026-03-16. No earlier version is on file. The next scheduled review is 2027-03-16.
units.source_span: Version 1 took effect on 2026-03-16. Member Experience issued this policy for the pharmacy desk and the insurance desk. No earlier version is on file. The next scheduled review is 2027-03-16.
